copy.text: Reading a row does nothing. Try sends that one order; Undo takes it back.
Each order sees the previous order’s result. The whole sequence makes one Undo step. If any order is rejected, nothing is applied.
Return restores the whole arrangement on this trip. Undo brings back the experiment you left.
Choose a lock to jump to its gates.

cases.title: Pocket Locks — Put the boat and gate controls before optional journey comparisons
cases.goal: Opening a trip shows its boat, water allowance and legal gate controls before a shelf of other journeys. Comparing starting water remains available without becoming the first thing to read.
cases.steps: Create closed details #trip-comparisons after section.controls and before #hint. Move these seven existing intact comparison drawers into it in their original order: chamber-comparison, prepared-comparison, secure-comparison, three-return-comparison, four-return-comparison, three-inspection-comparison, four-inspection-comparison. Move no trip label/select/name/description/mooring-rule/water-note: those stay before the canal. All inner drawer IDs, tables, buttons, row copy and selected family remain unchanged. Keep lock-preview, two-order-reader and canal-memory at their existing locations. Adjust scoped CSS formerly relying on .trip-picker ancestry so moved comparisons retain borders/spacing and phone wrapping. No app/engine changes or auto-opening a comparison.

groups.summary: Compare starting water on other journeys

cases.message: the boat and legal gate controls precede optional comparisons without changing any journey
